posts.title: Enabling HTTPS on services running in Home Network
posts.description: The Problem You’ve installed some web service on a server running in your home network e.g. hedgedoc running on a raspberry pi. Great, the world is bright and you’re feeling good about yourself. You’re excited and want to show your family. You send them the link to the webserver e.g. the ip address. Here begin the headaches.

posts.title: Integrating a Sungrow Inverter with Home Assistant over modbus
posts.description: Our inverter, that we purchased with the house and which was already over ten years old, recently crapped out and we needed to replace it. The electrician recommened we consider a sungrow 10KW inverter. It ticked all the boxes in terms of specs so we decided to go for it. Once it was installed I wanted to intergrate it into the instance of Home Assistant we have running.
